At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Successfully completed an internship with Blue Origin in 2026.
- Enrolled or recently graduating student attending a college or university.
- Able to start working full-time on or before September of 2027.
- Minimum of a B.S. degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, astronautical engineering, or equivalent.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team on rapid development programs.
- Self-driven with the ability to seek out requirements with minimal direction.
- Strong written, verbal, communication, and interpersonal skills.
- Passion for Blue’s Mission with a strong desire to continuously learn and improve.
- Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

- Relevant internship/co-op and academic project experience that demonstrate development of both technical skills relevant to the internship as well as leadership qualities.

- Co-curricular engagement.

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

- Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
- Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
- Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

- Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
- Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
- Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
- Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

We validate Micron memory products on current and next-generation computing platforms. As an Intern System Compatibility Engineer, you will join our System Enablement and Test Development teams and gain hands-on experience with platform bring-up, system configuration, memory validation, test development, automation, data analysis, and AI-enabled engineering workflows under the guidance of experienced engineers.

We will provide technical mentorship, structured onboarding, and exposure to DRAM, BIOS and firmware interactions, computer architecture, laboratory workflows, responsible use of approved AI tools, and the memory product lifecycle from initial bring-up through qualification and readiness.

Key Responsibilities

- Set up and support Intel, AMD, and ARM-based systems in Linux, Windows, and UEFI environments; document hardware, BIOS, firmware, operating system, memory, and test configurations for repeatable execution and traceability.

- Implement memory validation activities that assess compatibility, stability, reliability, performance, and platform readiness.
- Reproduce and triage failures, collect logs and diagnostic data, use issue-tracking systems, apply structured failure-analysis methods, and support validation of corrective actions.
- Build or refine automation using Python, PowerShell, C++, or related languages; use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate code development, test generation, log analysis, data summarization, technical research, documentation, and reporting while applying engineering judgment to verify accuracy and results.
- Apply responsible AI practices by protecting confidential information, using company-approved tools and data sources, documenting AI-assisted work where appropriate, identifying potential errors or bias, and independently validating generated code, analysis, and technical conclusions before use.
- Collaborate with System Enablement, Test Engineering, product, quality, and program teams on assigned validation and root-cause investigation activities.
- Communicate findings, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and recommended next steps through concise documentation and presentations.
- Internship Assignment - The intern will complete a bounded technical project or workstream with defined milestones, measurable deliverables, technical documentation, and a final presentation. The assignment will be selected to provide relevant business value while remaining achievable within a three-month summer internship!

Required Qualifications

- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical field. Must be continuing education in the fall term following the internship; the expected graduation date must not be before September of the same year.
- Foundational knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, computer architecture, and structured problem-solving.

- Programming or scripting experience gained through coursework, projects, laboratories, student organizations, or other technical experience using Python, PowerShell, C++, or a comparable language.
- Basic proficiency using AI-enabled tools to research technical topics, develop or solve code, analyze data, summarize findings, or improve documentation, with the ability to review outputs critically and confirm accuracy.
- Ability to follow test procedures, maintain accurate configuration records, analyze data, and summarize technical results. Interest in hands-on laboratory validation, system debug, test development, or engineering automation.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with DRAM, memory systems, BIOS or UEFI, firmware, server or client platforms, or hardware interfaces.

- Familiarity with x86 or ARM architectures, Intel, AMD, ARM-based, or embedded platforms, and Linux, Windows, or UEFI environments.
- Experience with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, power measurement equipment, or similar diagnostic tools.
- Experience applying generative AI, machine learning, automation, or data-analysis tools to an engineering or academic workflow—for example, developing code, generating tests, analyzing logs, identifying patterns, creating dashboards, improving documentation, or automating repetitive tasks.
- Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, adaptability, partnership, and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools and technologies.

As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays. For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits.

Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

To learn about your right to work click here.

To learn more about Micron, please visit micron.com/careers

For US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at hrsupport_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)

About Instead

Instead is where tax work gets done. Our AI agent orchestrates the entirety of how work gets done in tax, from preparation and compliance to filing and advisory. It's a fundamentally new way of doing tax work, and it's why top 500 firms, Big Four teams, and enterprise corporate tax departments are choosing Instead.

What makes us unique: we hold full government approvals with the IRS, 48 states, and all cities to e-file 1040, 1041, 1120, 1120S, and 1065, with 706, 709, 990, 5500, 2290, and PPT coming for tax year 2026. Instead is a full replacement for CCH Axcess, GoSystem, UltraTax, OneSource, CorpTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake, and more. No other tax startup will be able to offer these capabilities for years as we are two to three years ahead of everyone else in government approvals. This lets us build product experiences that are simply unmatched in the market.

Instead is backed by Conviction, IRIS (the largest tax software provider in the UK), Skylark, Aprio, and many of our partners and customers. Our team includes leaders from Intuit, Gusto, Zenefits, Thomson Reuters, Wolters Kluwer, PwC, BDO, RSM, and KPMG.

The Role

We're looking for Software Engineering Interns to join our San Francisco team and build real features on our AI-powered tax platform. This is not a coffee-fetching internship. You'll ship production code that hundreds of accounting firms use, work alongside senior engineers, and get hands-on experience building with AI tools from day one.

Our stack: Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend. Go, Docker on AWS ECS/Fargate, and PostgreSQL on AWS RDS on the backend. For AI, we use Cursor, Claude Code, Helicone, Gemini, and OpenAI, and we're constantly evaluating new tools.

What You'll Do

- Ship product features end to end on our live customer platform alongside senior engineers

- Build and test AI-powered components including inference pipelines and prompt engineering

- Fix bugs and make product improvements based on real customer feedback

- Create internal tools that make the engineering team more productive

- Learn our full stack and contribute across frontend, backend, and AI layers

- Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and product planning

What You Bring

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

- Strong programming fundamentals. You can write clean code, debug efficiently, and think about edge cases

- Familiarity with web development (frontend or backend). Experience with any modern framework counts

- Curiosity about AI and willingness to learn. Experience with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) is a plus

- High attention to detail and a bias for shipping

- Ability to work on-site in San Francisco

What Makes Someone Exceptional

- You've built and shipped side projects or open-source contributions that demonstrate your ability to go from idea to working product

- You already use AI tools in your coding workflow and understand how they change the way software gets built

- You learn fast and don't wait to be told what to do. When you see something broken, you fix it

- You care about the end user, not just the code. You want to understand why something matters before you build it

- You're excited about working at a startup where your work ships to real customers on day one

Location

San Francisco (on-site)

Instead is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates based on capability, judgment, ownership, and fit for the role's responsibilities. We welcome candidates who can help us build a category-defining company in tax technology.

About bp

bp operates at the heart of the global energy system, helping countries meet their energy needs and serving millions of customers every day. With world-class assets, technology, trading capability, and partnerships, we deliver energy at scale today while investing with discipline in the energy transition.

About the role

As a Seismic Imaging Technology intern at bp, you will collaborate with leading scientists on cutting-edge geophysical research and development. Your work will span advanced seismic acquisition techniques, imaging, data processing, and reservoir characterization. You’ll apply your expertise in digital signal processing, wave propagation, numerical simulation, inverse theory, and digital science to address complex subsurface challenges across exploration, development and production. Interns are expected to be proficient in modern programming languages and computing platforms and will implement and execute algorithms within bp’s High Performance Computing Center. Strong communication skills are essential for engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Successful interns may be considered for a full-time role within our One Subsurface programme upon earning their degree. One Subsurface is our early careers programme designed to create a pipeline of subsurface professionals. Early careers will follow a structured development offer to accelerate the acquisition of foundational technical skills, experience and knowledge, and application in the business world. The programme supports transition from university to discipline professional and provides a framework of ‘non-technical’ skills to support building personal effectiveness skills. Early careers will build their experience through challenging development assignments, grow a toolkit of transferable skills for the future, and have a dedicated network of support to help them succeed.

Our internships

Make an impact on cutting-edge projects. Help find solutions to complex challenges. Be part of a company that invests in you and your growth. You can do it all as an intern at bp. Our 12-week summer programme gives you the opportunity to build your technical knowledge, develop key skills and learn more about life at bp. You will be part of one team throughout your internship, supported by a dedicated line manager and buddy. There will be opportunities to connect with other interns, take part in training, and grow your network across the business.

Some of the wonderful things you’ll experience as a bp intern are:

- Project based roles for 12 weeks

- Typically for students between their penultimate and final year in program

- Assigned a buddy/mentor to help you transition into bp

- Attend events consist of networking, lunch & learn, executive calls, webinars, and community service opportunities across locations

- Comprehensive performance assessment process (goal setting, setting deliverables for projects, mid-term review, and final presentation)

- Retirement savings opportunities

- bp provided corporate housing with furnished apartments

- Relocation assistance (if eligible)

Minimum Requirements

- Pursuing a PhD degree in Geophysics or applied sciences are preferred.

- Graduating between December 2027 and May 2028

- Current Cumulative GPA Minimum 3.2

- On a case-by-case basis, bp may support US Immigration sponsorship for full-time or long- term employment.

- Must be available to start 12-week internship on May 17, 2027 or June 14, 2027 (will be required to pass all background and medical checks at least one week prior to start date)

Travel Requirement

Negligible travel should be expected with this role

Relocation Assistance:

This role is eligible for relocation within country

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working

Who We’re Looking For

Megazone Cloud is looking for a Software Engineer Co-op who is a "builder" at heart and eager to kickstart their career in a high-growth, global environment. You are passionate about deep-diving into software development, cloud architecture, and solving ambiguous, high-stakes technical problems.

As a Co-op, you won't just be watching from the sidelines. You will be a key part of our internal and client-facing teams, contributing to technical discovery, designing full-stack solutions, and collaborating with our senior experts to execute a clear vision. You are a fast learner with a thirst for knowledge and a desire to see your code make a real-world impact.

What You’ll Do

- Collaborate and Build: Work directly with senior engineers and our U.S. tech team to translate complex business requirements into functional software features and services.

- Own the Full Stack: Design, develop, test, and deploy software solutions, gaining hands-on experience with Python, Java, JavaScript, or Go.

- Be a Client-Facing Contributor: Participate in technical discussions and client meetings, effectively communicating progress on tickets, improvements, and deliverables.

- Solve the Unsolvable: Assist in troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to cloud infrastructure, applications, and services.

- Drive Modern Practices: Help implement monitoring solutions and lean into DevOps best practices, including CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.

- Learn and Multiply: Actively participate in design reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, leveraging our "force multiplier" culture to level up your skills and the team’s output.

What You Bring (Requirements)

- Educational Foundation: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Technical Curiosity: Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript, Go) and a strong grasp of programming/scripting fundamentals.

- Cloud Ambition: Exposure to or a deep interest in major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and modern data ecosystems.

- DevOps Mindset: Foundational knowledge of DevOps practices, including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation.

- Communication Excellence: Ability to translate technical concepts for different audiences and a desire to engage in a professional services/consulting environment.

- Startup Mentality: A strategic "builder" mindset, a sense of ownership, and the agility to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)

- Previous internship or project experience in a Professional Services or consulting environment.

- Experience with GenAI, MLOps, or specialized data tools (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake).

- Relevant AWS or cloud-provider certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner).

NOTE: We are unable to provide sponsorship for this position.

Why You'll Love It Here

- Our Product is Our People: We live by this. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your growth is our growth.

- True Servant Leadership: Our CTO leads with a "force multiplier" philosophy. Management is here to empower you and clear roadblocks, not to micromanage. We won't ask you to do anything we're not willing to do ourselves.

- Flat Organization, Real Impact: Your voice and designs will directly shape our technical roadmap and our clients' success. You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems.

- A "Learn-from-it" Culture: We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures.

We seek diverse talent who are ready to make an immediate impact. We believe that innovation thrives when teams are built with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you are excited by this mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed.

Megazone Cloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires.

Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX.

What You Will Do

Immerse yourself in a full-time, Monday-Friday co-op session, that will run January-August (including the Spring semester; it is expected students will take a semester off from coursework to fully engage with this working mentorship opportunity).

We are seeking a Spring/Summer Co-op for our Avionics Software Tools team based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. The Avionics Software Tools team is responsible for Avionics Function tools - delivering tools that configure Avionics products, and Integrated Modular Architecture systems tools - that enable systems engineers to design and deploy aircraft software and systems I/O for aircraft platforms. This engineer will work in a team of software and systems engineers driving solutions for DO-330 qualified tools, simulation and infrastructure tools for multiple avionics applications. The team supports Collins Avionics Commercial and Military platforms. Our team builds cloud and desktop environments for use in dev ops pipelines, desktop deployments and external customers that enable configuration of Avionics products used on aircraft.

- Perform in a cross-functional engineering team.
- Work in close coordination with a mentor using Collins Aerospace engineering processes.
- Develop tools used in Avionics for software development in a Dev Ops environment.

What You Will Learn

- How software tools are developed, deployed, and used in Avionics for certification of airborne software and aircraft systems.
- How to work in a multidisciplinary team delivering solutions used by Collins engineers to produce Avionics products.

Qualifications You Must Have

- Must be pursuing Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session.
- Must have a minimum of 90 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session.
- Programming in C / C++ / C# / Java / Python.
- Microsoft Windows 11 experience, and familiarity with operating and using software on PCs.
- Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

Qualifications We Prefer

- Object-oriented programming experience.
- Familiar with software containers.
- Familiarity with automated testing of software, through unit tests, functional testing and/or high-level test.
- Familiar with DevOps concepts and CI/CD practices.
- Tools commonly used in pipelines such as Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Grafana, Artifactory, Jenkins, etc.
- Prior RTX internship, co-op, or work experience.

What We Offer

- Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
- Relocation Eligibility

Learn More & Apply Now!

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

- Develop a Power BI dashboard that predicts future past-due backlog based on Customer Required Date (CRD), Planned Ship Date (PSD), model code, value stream, and material status, enabling planners to answer, "What will be late next month?" with data-driven confidence.
- Build weekly projected late backlog forecasts, top model code risk heat maps, and simulation tools that quantify the impact of material availability, capacity constraints, and scheduling decisions on backlog recovery.
- Create a predictive surge capacity model for low-volume product lines (e.g., CMFHC) that identifies demand mix variation, highlights bottlenecks by operation, and produces growth scenario analyses to guide investment prioritization and lead time stability.
- Apply data science methodologies, including statistical modeling, forecasting, and visualization, to translate complex operational datasets into actionable insights for planners, operations leaders, and SIOP discussions.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including supply chain planning, operations, and engineering to validate models, gather requirements, and ensure analytical tools align with business priorities and decision-making workflows.
- Participate in multiple analytical projects at various stages, from data exploration and model development to dashboard deployment and user training, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the data science project lifecycle in a manufacturing context.

- You are analytically minded and naturally curious, energized by turning raw data into clear, actionable insights. You take initiative in exploring new tools and methodologies, and you're not afraid to dive into ambiguous problems to find structure and meaning. You communicate complex findings in ways that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences. You thrive in collaborative environments and build strong relationships across teams, bringing enthusiasm and rigor to every project you touch.

- Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in engineering
- Zero (0) years of related experience
- Ability to work full-time (40 hours) per week in-person
- Legal authorization to work in the United States

- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization platforms
- Familiarity with Python, R, SQL, or statistical modeling techniques
- Prior internship or project experience in data analytics, operations research, or supply chain
- Exposure to manufacturing, supply chain planning, or ERP/MES systems

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

The Marvell Advanced Packaging team is responsible for supporting customers with package designs that meet challenging electrical requirements. High speed signaling and challenging power delivery networks require complex and custom solutions to meet constantly advancing application needs. Many of the new designs require multi-chip and multiple component configurations with high-speed IP requirements. In addition, our team is advancing Marvell's expertise in 3D packaging, Co-packaged optics and cutting-edge substrate materials. We work with the world's leading manufacturers to solve our client's most challenging designs and integrations with industry-leading packaging techniques.

The ideal candidate will have an interest in hardware design and experience working on signal and power integrity verification and design optimization. A knowledge of Electrical Engineering concepts, circuit extractions and simulation, as well as design methodology and strategies is required.

- Executing simulation tasks for signal and power integrity sign-off

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program studying Electrical Engineering, planning to complete studies in 2028.

31 - 62, $ per hour.

OVERVIEW:

At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we believe in how positively sports can change lives. On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

We take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join the Technology team as an Intern at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. We help our Athletes and fellow Teammates better their best by innovating solutions to interesting business problems and empowering every Technology Teammate to be an innovator. And, while our broader Technology team works remotely from all over the United States, they provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park. As a DICK’S Sporting Goods Technology Intern, you will spend your Summer in Pittsburgh working at our Customer Support Center (our Corporate Office)! We follow a hybrid work schedule, in the office Tuesday – Thursday and working from home (your apartment) Monday and Friday.

DSG’s Technology Interns work with and learn from the leaders who bring our vision to the Best Sports Company in the World to life. During the 11-week Summer experience, interns are assigned a strategic project that is selected by a leader on their Technology team. At the conclusion of the summer, you will present your project directly to your leadership team. As a bonus to our program, you will have regular Q&A sessions with senior leaders, take part in a visit to our multiple store banners, and interact with teammates across the organization including networking and volunteer opportunities.

To support you throughout the Summer, we have built a strong support system of managers and mentors. For project guidance and day-to-day management, you will be paired with a Training Manager. Additionally, you will have status-checks and coaching from both leaders in our Technology Department and our University Relations Team. You will also have peer mentorship from Technology teammates earlier in their career. This support structure will aid in transitioning you to the DSG team, the exploration of your career goals, and will provide opportunities to develop professional and social networks within the company and the retail industry.

The experiential learning you will receive enables you to rapidly become a contributing member of the team, while also focusing on your own personal development. If you join DSG, you will have the opportunity to be a part of an enthusiastic and supportive team culture, be challenged to make a meaningful difference in our business decisions, and get a peek behind the curtain of how a large company thinks about its growth strategies.

As a Product Management Intern, you will look to discover, understand, and communicate product management methodologies and frameworks to create intuitive, loveable products. Interns will work in a fast-paced, lean environment, collaborating closely with other interns, as well as full-time Product designers, product managers, and software engineers.

We are looking for people with hybrid talents who are curious, passionate about problem solving, and can drive successful product outcomes in support of our customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy – You will learn the following while working with a Product Management coach:

• Use data to identify customer pain points
• Participate in sessions to identify the right problems
• Participate in prioritizing problems for best business outcomes
• Gather & analyze market data inclusive of creating competitive analyses, bench market or SWOT presentations
• Participate in identifying patterns in data & build expanded research models
• Create & present reports on findings, defects, improvements, statuses & risk management
• Use decision support tools to weigh the competing factors for prioritization of backlog
• Contribute to team discovery efforts

Execution – You will learn the following while working on a Product Team

• Tasked with key projects & provides support to more senior-level Product Managers
• Scoping & prioritization of tasks that are assigned to you
• Perform validation for production releases, bug fixes & feature requests
• Troubleshoot defects, participate in root cause analysis & find solutions for resolution
• Work on specific features, improving them & creating new ones upon instruction
• Participate in Agile ceremonies, including planning, grooming, demos & retrospectives
• Write user stories to articulate work to be done by Engineering that support outcome delivery
• Work closely with engineering to ensure delivery of products map to customer experience & business requirements within needed timelines

Key Deliverables of a Product Manager at DICK’S Sporting Goods

• Stakeholder Relationship Management
• Competitive Gap Analysis & Benchmarking
• Product Data Analysis & Reporting
• Writing & Grooming User Stories
• User Acceptance Testing

Some of your experiences will include:

• Multi-day intern orientation to introduce you to the company, the program, Pittsburgh, and your teammates
• Professional development workshops designed to increase your knowledge of the company and the retail industry, as well as develop your business acumen and office professionalism
• Extensive exposure to our senior leadership through our exclusive intern only Executive Speaker Series which includes a private meet & greet with our CEO
• Opportunities to “live the brand” and experience summer fun outside the office through various events
• Working a 40-hour work week, Monday – Friday

Skills we are looking for:

• A foundational understanding of Product Management
• Ability to balance business objectives and customer needs
• Strong deductive reasoning skills
• A customer-centric view into developing great product experiences
• Ability to distill complex technical concepts into plain language for stakeholders
• Strong curiosity when it comes to using new tools, adopting new technology, and learning new product management frameworks that will progress your professional development
• Dynamic written and verbal communication style, as well as the ability to communicate cross-functionally and vertically throughout the organization
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and outcome-oriented environment

We look for potential candidates with:

• Attending an accredited university, college or technical school
• Graduation date of Winter 2027 or Spring 2028
• An undergrad or Master’s degree in Product Management, Business, Technology or related field

Internship Start Date: May 17th 2027
Internship End Date: July 29th 2027

Full-time opportunities in 2028:

Interns qualified for full-time opportunities will be evaluated at the end of the program. Qualified interns will be placed into a full-time Technology Development Program.

Perks:

- Consideration for full-time jobs after graduation*

- Fully furnished housing for non-local interns arranged and paid for by DSG

- Hybrid work model: WFH Monday & Friday, in office Tues – Thurs.

- Two paid holidays – Memorial Day and July 4th

- Teammate Discount

- Uber codes for Interns who do not have a vehicle to commute to and from the office

- Corporate Office amenities such as on-site gym and Starbucks

- Meaningful work projects selected by functional leaders

- Executive Speaker Series

- Professional development

- Volunteer opportunities

- Social events such as Intern Olympics, a Pittsburgh Pirates game, National Intern Day celebration, and more!

*Relocation assistance will be provided for non-local candidates who accept full-time jobs requiring them to be located at DICK’S Sporting Goods Corporate Office

Here’s what a few of our 2025 Interns had to say:

“At DSG, we don’t just identify challenges but have the opportunity to shape the solutions. Knowing that my voice matters and my work drives real impact across the company has been incredibly empowering. If you’re willing to show up and put in the work, DSG will grow you in ways you never thought possible.” – Kelsey Riemer, People & Purpose Intern

“During my internship at DSG, what I loved most was the incredible opportunity to immerse myself in a company that is not only large and well-established, but also rapidly growing and constantly evolving. As someone interested in the retail industry, it was great to be part of such a dynamic environment allowed me to develop deep expertise in my role, gain hands-on experience, and see firsthand how continuous improvement in all areas drives the company forward.” – Jackson Lopiano, Retail Analytics Intern

“My internship at DICK’S Sporting Goods was an incredible experience. I loved being part of a team that truly values collaboration, growth, and innovation. One of the best parts was getting to meet other interns and learn about different areas of the business. It gave me a much deeper understanding of how everything connects. I also appreciated how immersed I was in the DICK’S culture from day one. It’s a place where people are passionate about what they do, and that energy is contagious. I felt supported, challenged, and inspired throughout the entire program.” – Kristin Bayuk, Finance Intern

“I loved that this internship not only let me work on a project that would benefit the team, but it also exposed me to what working at DSG and in the corporate world would look like. Being given the responsibility to complete important tasks and seeing the trust instilled in me by my teammates to do the work and contribute to the team was invaluable to me. All of my teammates wanted to see me grow and I felt like I could in this space.” – Emery Rios, Cybersecurity Intern

“My internship experience at Dick’s Sporting Goods was incredibly rewarding. I felt genuinely supported by my team, who took the time to teach me and involve me in meaningful projects that contributed to the business. I especially appreciated the collaborative environment and the opportunity to apply both creative and strategic thinking. This experience has strengthened my passion for the retail industry, and I would love the opportunity to come back and continue growing with the DSG team in the future." – Sarah Cyphers, Merchandising Intern

- Customer (Digital) Experiences (CX, AR/VR): Developing systems and tools to enable customer interactions and collaboration
- Commercial Excellence: Developing systems and tools to enable commercial capabilities to serve the customer
- Software Engineering: Engineering custom, fast, clean, and reliable code that drives business outcomes
- Cloud, DevOps & Security: Architecture, Engineering, and Automation professionals focused on developing cloud policy as code, compliance as code, infrastructure as code, and continuous Integration (CI)/Continuous Deployment (CD) product pipelines
- Cybersecurity: Combination of people, policies, processes, and technologies employed by an enterprise to protect its cyber assets
- Device Engineering: Focused on developing medical-grade intelligent, connected devices and capabilities
- Digital (Agile) Mindset: Focus on Business agility, Agile delivery with a fail-fast mindset, and measurable outcomes
- Platform Engineering: Engineering flexible and cost-effective platform ecosystems that allow for multiple products within a single framework and open integrations

- Work within specialized groups in the JJT organization to build solutions for business partners and drive value

- Work with key stakeholders to accomplish goals and objectives to support the J&J Technology project/program portfolio
- Build awareness and experience of key capability skills in support of the J&J Technology Strategy
- Conduct data and process analysis to support development of key solutions

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

As an Associate Product Manager, you will join a team that works diligently to understand and solve our customers’ most challenging problems. We're hiring across all of our teams, including AI Platform, Genie, Machine Learning, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, ETL, Streaming, and EDA. As part of our 2027 APM cohort, you will have a dedicated manager and mentor as well as connect with product managers, engineers, designers, account teams, other interns, and leaders from across the company.

We are hiring for San Francisco, CA, Mountain View, CA, and Bellevue, WA.

The impact you will have:

- Deeply understand customer problem space and establish the rails for viable solution space

- Prototype and test early ideas with customers and engineers to validate direction before the team commits to a build

- Work with engineers and designers to ship features on the Databricks platformWork with a team to build features for the Databricks platform

- Own your project end-to-end — design, build, launch, and iterate on feedbackManage your project end-to-end, including design, code, launch and feedback

- Build with scale, quality, and security in mind from day oneLearn about building a platform that scales quickly while maintaining quality and security

What we look for:

- You will graduate in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 with a bachelors or masters degree in computer science or related engineering practice

- Pursuing a bachelor's or master's in computer science or a related engineering field

- You've used AI tooling for both personal productivity and development projects

- You have some first hand experience with SQL and/or Python

- You're hands-on and learn by doing — happy to build, test, and iterate your way to an answer

- You use analytical skills to make data-driven decisions (e.g. analyzing product usage)

- You can make complex topics simple and communicate nuance to partners (engineers, customers, field) in both written and verbal form

- You're excited to solve ambiguous problems with a collaborative team

- You stay curious and keep learning, whether it's a new technology, a customer's domain, or a corner of the product you haven't touched
